document.purpose: Provide concise project context for future Sophia AI development conversations.
document.note: Verify the current Git diff and source code before assuming every historical item remains unchanged.

project.name: Sophia AI
project.backend: Node.js API and worker in backend/
project.businessDomain: Real-estate property search, property information, requirements, and inspection booking

avatarPlans.reason: Avatar quality was not acceptable for the presentation.

frontendRequirements.layout: Sophia uses the full available width and height between the header and footer for all enabled plans.
frontendRequirements.mediaPositioning: Preserve image/video aspect ratio, prioritize keeping the avatar head visible, and crop from the bottom when necessary.
frontendRequirements.propertyGallery: Display three property photos, allow users to enlarge a photo in a centered modal, provide a close action, and close the photo modal when another workflow panel such as inspection times opens.
frontendRequirements.modalBackdrop: Use a dark translucent backdrop while the enlarged-photo modal is open.
frontendRequirements.bookingConfirmation: Show editable customer name and email before sending, update displayed details when they change, ask for confirmation, and allow corrected-address resends.
frontendRequirements.requirementsPanel: When Sophia explains buying, selling, or rental requirements, also display those requirements on screen.
frontendRequirements.temporaryErrors: Transient error messages should disappear after four seconds.
frontendRequirements.idleBehavior: Do not end a session while Sophia or the user is speaking. When genuinely idle, prompt after 20 seconds and close after a further 5 seconds without a response.

conversationBehavior.requirements: Sophia should provide common agency requirements directly for this demonstration. She should not add the phrase 'this is not legal advice' and should not claim she lacks the knowledge.
conversationBehavior.bookingTimes: Spoken and displayed inspection times must use the same source value and Australia/Brisbane timezone formatting.
conversationBehavior.emailCorrection: A user may correct an email before delivery or request a resend after delivery.
conversationBehavior.saleReportMessage: After a BUY inspection is booked, Sophia should say: Your inspection is booked. I'm also preparing the property report and will include it with your confirmation email.
conversationBehavior.saleReportConstraint: Sophia must not say the confirmation email was already sent while the property report is still queued or generating.

townPlannerIntegration.scope: Generate and attach a Town Planner PDF only for BUY inspection bookings. Rental inspection confirmation remains unchanged.
townPlannerIntegration.criticalPath: The inspection booking is committed first and never waits for PDF generation.
townPlannerIntegration.queueTechnology: PostgreSQL tables act as the durable queue inside the existing backend and worker deployment.
townPlannerIntegration.workerDeployment: Reuse backend/cron/weeklyGenerator.js; no additional paid worker service is required during development.

globalConcurrency.mechanism: PostgreSQL advisory locks plus FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED row claims

reportCaching.goal: Reuse a valid property-specific report rather than regenerate it for every buyer.

idempotency.emailSemantics: Delivery is at-least-once; a provider success followed by a process crash before the database commit can cause a duplicate retry.

reportRetryPolicy.afterInitialFailure: Send the booking confirmation without the PDF and retry report generation once per day.
reportRetryPolicy.recoveryBehavior: If a daily retry succeeds after the fallback email, send a follow-up email containing the report.

leases.recovery: Expired running leases are returned to an eligible retry state.

townPlannerIntegration.storage: Generated PDFs are stored in the existing S3 integration; the queue row stores pdf_key and pdf_url.
townPlannerIntegration.emailProviders: The attachment path supports the existing log, SMTP, and Amazon SES configurations.

implementationPhases.scope: Database queue schema, report versioning, cache key, booking transaction integration, and BUY-only enqueue behavior.
Report worker, global concurrency control, leases, cache reuse, three initial attempts, and daily recovery.
Durable email delivery worker, PDF attachments, retries, and confirmation fallback without a report.
Sophia runtime behavior, pending-report messaging, resend/corrected-email handling, and frontend pending status.
Release audit, shared worker advisory-lock fix, configuration validation, daily-recovery follow-up email, builds, tests, and operational documentation.

Run one real BUY booking against the deployed PostgreSQL, Town Planner, S3, and email integrations.
Confirm the booking API returns immediately while the PDF continues in the worker.
Confirm the generated PDF is attached to the correct recipient's email.
Exercise three report failures, fallback email delivery, and a later successful daily retry.
Monitor queue states and worker logs using backend/docs/sophia-property-report-workflow.md.
